original_title: CoD Season 4 Patch Notes Detail SG-12 Nerf, Anti-Cheat Updates, And More
summary_en: The latest Call of Duty Season 4 update is live, bringing significant weapon balancing, crucial anti-cheat enhancements, and exciting new content across Black Ops 7 and Warzone.
ai_analysis: This update directly addresses player feedback on weapon balance and cheating, while also teasing future content and a classic gameplay mode that should appeal to long-time fans.

en.title: Call of Duty Season 4 Nerfs SG-12, Boosts Anti-Cheat, and Revamps Maps
en.summary: The latest Call of Duty Season 4 update is live, bringing significant weapon balancing, crucial anti-cheat enhancements, and exciting new content across Black Ops 7 and Warzone.
en.body:
The battlefield is shifting once again as **Call of Duty Season 4** officially drops for **Black Ops 7** and **Warzone**, bringing a wave of changes designed to refine the player experience. At the forefront of these adjustments is a much-anticipated nerf to the formidable **SG-12 shotgun**, a weapon that has dominated close-quarters engagements for many. This move signals the developers' commitment to maintaining a balanced meta, ensuring that no single weapon reigns supreme indefinitely.

Beyond weapon tuning, Season 4 introduces significant upgrades to the game's security infrastructure. New anti-cheat measures are now in effect for PC players, utilizing Microsoft Azure Attestation (MAA) checks. Players on PC must successfully complete this attestation process to access all playlists, with those who don't being funneled into a more limited selection, including **Nuketown 24/7** in **Black Ops 7** and **Battle Royale Casual** in **Warzone**. This initiative aims to foster a fairer playing field for everyone across the vast Call of Duty ecosystem.

## What's New in Season 4

The content drop for Season 4 is substantial, featuring a brand-new Battle Pass packed with cosmetic rewards and functional items. A new operator for the Guild faction joins the fray, alongside a host of new weapons and additional maps to explore. For **Warzone** players, a new self-revive kit has been added, offering a critical lifeline in intense survival scenarios. **Zombies** mode also receives map improvements, promising fresh challenges and enhanced gameplay for fans of the undead horde.

Furthermore, **Treyarch** is tapping into nostalgia with a "classic" multiplayer moshpit playlist. This mode is inspired by the movement and gameplay mechanics of **Black Ops 2**, specifically removing the game's omnimovement, sliding, and wall-jump abilities. This feature is a direct nod to the franchise's history and will likely be a major draw for veteran players seeking a more grounded combat experience.

## Looking Ahead for Call of Duty Fans

The excitement doesn't stop with the current season. Hype is already building for this year's mainline **Call of Duty** release, officially revealed as **Modern Warfare 4**. This upcoming title will feature a full campaign, a robust multiplayer suite, and the popular DMZ extraction mode. Pre-orders are live, with Activision offering a "Loyalty" discount of 10% on the Vault Edition for returning players. The Season 4 patch notes, detailed by **Activision**, lay the groundwork for continued evolution within the **Call of Duty** universe, with more updates and content promised throughout the season.

What's Next

With Season 4 now live, players can dive into the new content and experience the balancing changes firsthand. The introduction of new weapons and operators, coupled with the classic playlist, ensures a dynamic and engaging period for **Call of Duty** fans. The focus on anti-cheat also signals a long-term commitment to a healthy player community as we anticipate further news on **Modern Warfare 4**.

tr.title: Call of Duty Season 4: SG-12'yı Zayıflattı, Anti-Cheating Güçlendirildi ve Haritalar Yenilendi
tr.summary: Call of Duty Season 4 güncellemesi canlı, Black Ops 7 ve Warzone için önemli silah dengelenmesi, kritik anti-cheating iyileştirmeleri ve heyecan verici yeni içerik getirdi.
tr.body:
Call of Duty Season 4, Black Ops 7 ve Warzone için resmi olarak yayınlandı ve oynanış deneyimini iyileştirmek için tasarlanan önemli değişiklikler getirdi. SG-12 jiroskoplu tüfek gibi güçlü silahların dengelenmesine odaklanılmış bu değişiklikler, geliştiricilerin dengeli metayi korumak için çabaladıklarını gösteriyor.

Gücün dengelenmesi dışında, Season 4, oyunun güvenlik altyapısını önemli ölçüde iyileştirmektedir. Yeni anti-cheating önlemleri, PC kullanıcıları için Microsoft Azure Attestation (MAA) kontrollerini kullanmaktadır. PC kullanıcıları, bu attestation sürecini başarıyla tamamlamalıdır; aksi takdirde, tüm listelerde erişilemez olur ve sınırlı bir seçenekten yararlanmaya zorlanırlar, bu da Black Ops 7'de Nuketown 24/7 ve Warzone'de Battle Royale Casual'dir.

## Season 4'de Yeni İçerik

Season 4, yeni bir Battle Pass ile büyük bir içerik paketi sunmaktadır. Battle Pass, kozmetik ödüller ve işlevsel maddeler içerir. Guild ekibi için yeni bir operatör ve yeni silahlar ile birlikte, yeni haritalar keşfetmek için oyuncuları bekliyor. Warzone oyuncuları için, yeni bir self-revive seti eklendi, bu da hayati bir destek sağlar.

Zombies modu, harita iyileştirmeleri ile yenilendi ve oyunculara yeni meydan okumalar sunar.

## Nostalji Modu: Black Ops 2'nin Klasik Oyunculuğu

Treyarch, nostalji modunu sunuyor: Black Ops 2'nin hareket ve oyun mekanizmalarını temel alan bir klasik oyunculuk moshpit listesi. Bu liste, oyunun hareket yeteneklerini kaldırarak, oyunculara daha gerçekçi bir savaş deneyimi sunuyor.

## Call of Duty Fans için Gelecek

Bu sezonun heyecanı, gelecek yılki ana Call of Duty yayınları ile devam ediyor. Modern Warfare 4, tam bir kampanya, gelişmiş multiplayer ve popüler DMZ extraction modu ile ön plana çıkıyor. Pre-orderlar canlı, Activision, returning oyuncular için 10% "Loyalty" indirimini sunuyor. Season 4 patch notları, Activision tarafından detaylandırıldı ve Call of Duty universe'ünde devam eden evrimi desteklemektedir.

es.title: Lanzamiento de la Temporada 4 de Call of Duty: Armas rebajadas, seguridad mejorada y nuevos mapas
es.summary: La Temporada 4 de Call of Duty está disponible, traída por Black Ops 7 y Warzone, con actualizaciones significativas en el equilibrio de armas, el mejoramiento de la seguridad y contenido nuevo en toda la plataforma.
es.body:
La batalla cambia de nuevo con el lanzamiento oficial de la Temporada 4 de Call of Duty para Black Ops 7 y Warzone, que trae consigo una oleada de cambios diseñados para mejorar la experiencia del jugador. A la cabeza de estas ajustaciones se encuentra una nerf muy esperada a la formidable escopeta SG-12, un arma que ha dominado las batallas cuerpo a cuerpo durante mucho tiempo. Este movimiento indica el compromiso de los desarrolladores con mantener un meta equilibrado, asegurando que ninguna arma reine indefinidamente.

Más allá de la tunificación de armas, la Temporada 4 introduce mejoras significativas en la infraestructura de seguridad del juego. Nuevas medidas de lucha contra el fraude están en vigor para los jugadores de PC, utilizando verificaciones de Microsoft Azure Attestation (MAA). Los jugadores de PC deben completar con éxito este proceso de attestation para acceder a todas las listas de reproducción, mientras que aquellos que no lo hacen se verán redirigidos a una selección más limitada, incluyendo Nuketown 24/7 en Black Ops 7 y Battle Royale Casual en Warzone. Esta iniciativa busca crear un campo de juego más justo para todos en el vasto ecosistema de Call of Duty.

## Nuevos contenidos en la Temporada 4

El contenido lanzado para la Temporada 4 es sustancial, con un nuevo Battle Pass lleno de recompensas cosméticas y artículos funcionales. Un nuevo operador para la facción Guild se une a la batalla, junto con una variedad de armas nuevas y mapas adicionales para explorar. Para los jugadores de Warzone, se ha agregado un kit de auto-revivir, ofreciendo una vida crítica en escenarios de supervivencia intensos. El modo Zombies también recibe mejoras en los mapas, prometiendo nuevos desafíos y una experiencia de juego mejorada para los fanáticos de la horda zombi.

Además, Treyarch está reviviendo la nostalgia con una playlist de moshpit de multiplicador clásico. Este modo está inspirado en el movimiento y los mecanismos de juego de Black Ops 2, específicamente eliminando las habilidades de omnimovimiento, deslizamiento y salto en pared. Esta característica es un homenaje directo a la historia de la franquicia y probablemente será un atractivo importante para jugadores veteranos que buscan una experiencia de combate más terrenal.

## Próximos pasos para los fanáticos de Call of Duty

La emoción no se detiene con la temporada actual. La expectación ya se está construyendo para la próxima entrega principal de Call of Duty, oficialmente revelada como Modern Warfare 4. Este título próximo incluirá una campaña completa, un conjunto de multiplicadores robusto y el popular modo DMZ de extracción. Los pedidos anticipados están disponibles, con Activision ofreciendo un descuento de lealtad del 10% en la edición Vault para jugadores que regresan. Los anuncios de parches de la Temporada 4, detallados por Activision, establecen las bases para la evolución continua dentro del universo de Call of Duty, con más actualizaciones y contenido prometido a lo largo de la temporada.

content_raw: Season 4 goes live in Black Ops 7 and Warzone on June 4, and the developer's patch notes reveal all the major changes for Call of Duty’s various modes. These adjustments include a nerf for the powerful SG-12 shotgun, a new self-revive kit for Warzone, and map improvements for Zombies. Content-wise, Season 4 of Black Ops 7 and Warzone adds a new battle pass, another operator for the Guild faction, more guns, and additional maps. New seasons of Ranked Play arrive for both multiplayer and Warzone. Treyarch also introduces a "classic" multiplayer moshpit playlist inspired by Black Ops 2's movement and gameplay, which will remove the game's omnimovement, sliding, and wall-jump abilities. In other news, hype is already building for this year's new Call of Duty release. Activision officially revealed Modern Warfare 4 last week, and the game will include a campaign, multiplayer, and DMZ extraction mode. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 preorders  are live, and Activision has also confirmed  a “Loyalty” discount  that allows players to get 10% off the game’s Vault edition. The Season 4 patch notes for both Black Ops 7 and Warzone can be found below, as shared by Activision. New anti-cheat measures are live As previously announced , Call of Duty's new security checks are now in effect for players on PC. Microsoft Azure Attestation (MAA) checks will place PC players into a separate matchmaking pool. To access all playlists, players must successfully complete the MAA process. Because the pool of players who haven't passed our attestation checks is small, access is limited to a select set of playlists to help maintain healthy matchmaking. Players who do not complete the required checks will be limited to Nuketown 24/7 in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 and the Battle Royale Casual playlist inWarzone. This requirement helps protect the integrity of the game and the experience of the broader community. More detailed instructions for how to make a PC compliant can be found on Activision's blog . SG-12 shotgun nerf in multiplayer The only multiplayer weapon tuning for Season 4's launch is a nerf to the overpowered SG-12 shotgun when using the 12 Gauge Dragon's Breath attachment. This reduces the damage range with this ammo type, as well as how many pellets are fired per shot. The developer says this should put the power of this attachment more in line with the base ammo type. Season 4's Launch map Weapon tuning for Endgame Endgame doesn't normally receive the same weapon tuning as multiplayer and Warzone, but the developer says it wanted to improve some of the more specialized and challenging weapons to use. Notably, this includes a massive buff to the M34 Novaline marksman rifle with a 50% damage boost, which Treyarch says should help it feel more powerful as a slower, precision weapon.
